stages.purpose: Confirm D8 handoff is green; locate capture manifests with placeholder `media_ref`; inventory running web companion and Omniverse Kit capture ability; refuse to proceed green if neither surface can be captured.
Lock the operator/executive/moment shot list and capture toolchain. Map every capture target to a certified D8 moment or hero-spine beat. Keep M04/M05 as partial unless real option-set fields exist.
Run the live local surfaces and capture operator and executive walkthrough media. Actual media files must be copied into the output root or referenced by stable local paths and hashed.
Cut or index moment-level clips for the 10 demonstrable moments. Each clip must show claim label, limitation/boundary where applicable, and the Mobility Access certified spine.

Audit all captured media and transcripts for boundary claims. Reject any frame/narration implying production, live autonomous monitoring, dispatch, routing/control, enforcement, legal/certified finding, or automated action.
Close the media pass only if placeholder refs were replaced or explicitly preserved as known pending. Summarize operator/executive/moment clip coverage.

Prepare external viewer validation. Require consent/anonymous IDs only; no sensitive personal data. Check whether viewer-session input files exist; if not, create templates and mark pending, not green.
Create the viewer packet: short intro, operator/executive media links, moment checklist, comprehension questions, surprise-moment question, boundary-understanding question.
Import manually collected external viewer session records from a local input folder. Do not invent records. Validate schema, anonymize viewer IDs, and preserve raw vs normalized evidence.
Score external validation: unaided understanding, identified surprise moment, boundary understood, moments remembered, confusion points. Keep all scoring evidence-backed.
Close external validation only if real viewer records exist. If not, output a clean pending package and do not claim external validation.
Start front-end remediation from actual capture/viewer/confusion evidence plus D8 defect ledgers. If there are no real defects yet, produce an issue seed ledger and wait for external/capture inputs.
Triage web companion and Omniverse Kit issues by P0/P1/P2. P0: boundary drift, one-truth mismatch, broken live drive, unreadable moment. No substrate work.
Patch web companion issues: option/tradeoff legibility, trace panel readability, Track D stop visibility, limitation ledger visibility, media/capture readiness. Run targeted tests.
Patch Omniverse Kit depth issues: hero corridor framing, overlay labels, asset highlighting, camera path, moment callouts, capture readiness. Do not claim certified geometry or control.
Run one-truth regression after patches: web, Kit, trace, option set, Track D panel, limitation ledger, and capture manifests must agree on IDs, statuses, boundaries.
Close front-end remediation if P0 issues are zero and P1 issues are either fixed or accepted with reason. Produce patch log and remaining issue backlog.
Reconcile D8 handoff, live media pass, external validation, and front-end remediation. Fail-safe if any required real media/viewer evidence is missing unless explicitly deferred.
Review final follow-through package for completeness, media hashes, viewer evidence, patch regression, and boundary preservation.
Create the certified handoff that names what is now externally/watchably demonstrable, what remains pending, and what is parked post-D8.

hard_gates: real media required for capture green
external viewer records required for naive-viewer green
not_executed and Track D authority preserved
